saints.name: St. Severinus of Noricum
saints.title: Abbot, Apostle of Noricum
saints.shortBlurb: A monk who came out of the East to shepherd a frightened Roman frontier as the Western Empire collapsed…
biography: Severinus appeared in the province of Noricum, along the Danube, in the middle of the fifth century, his earlier life unknown by his own choice. As Roman authority crumbled under the barbarian migrations, he became the counselor and protector of the terrified population, ransoming captives, feeding the poor, and organizing defense.

Barbarian kings such as Odoacer honored him, yet he lived as a humble monk and foretold the fortunes of the peoples around him. He died in 482, and his life was written soon after by his disciple Eugippius.
saints.knownFor: Protecting the people of Noricum as Roman rule collapsed.
